explanation: C₁₄ ≤ 230 (Glazer 2026). This is not yet on Tao's page, but I confirmed that the elliotglazer/k230-rocq repository (Oct 2026) contains an axiom-free Rocq proof that the 230-state K230 halts iff ZFC is inconsistent. Independence then follows from Gödel II together with the Σ₁-soundness of ZFC, both available in Lean's metatheory. The statement is correct.
